provenance.label: OFFLINE DRY-RUN FIXTURE — hand-authored synthetic discussion. This is not a MiroFish run and must never be reported as one.
provenance.warning: Live simulation was not executed. Every observation below is fictional material designed to exercise the extraction, validation, coverage, and execution pipeline offline.

observations.text: I shared the invitation with Bob on Tuesday and assumed that meant we were connected. I kept writing notes. When he opened the app he said he had to join something first, and I realised the share sheet had told me nothing about whether he was actually in the space.

The code in our old message just said it was invalid. It did not say it had expired. I tried it twice, then typed it again in case I had confused a zero with an O. We nearly made a second space because I thought the first one was broken.

I did not understand that Chen had to join my space. I thought creating the space was the setup and the other person would appear automatically. When nothing happened I created another space with our names, which made it worse.
Farah and I both had the same note open. She fixed a sentence and saved. I saved my version a minute later without reloading. If the app lets my old copy win, I would never know I erased her edit.

I attached a photo and the preview appeared straight away, so I closed the app. The next day the memory was there but the photo was a grey box. I had assumed the preview meant the upload had finished.

Kai deleted a note while I was reading it. I went back and it just vanished. I did not know whether he had removed it or whether the app had lost it. I also want to know that I cannot accidentally delete his words.

I put a photo in the sky because it looked like the place for photos. Later I looked in Memories for it and it was not there. Alice said the sky and the memories are different, but I still do not know which button makes which one.

I saved a memory with a photo and expected the sky to change. Nothing happened, so I saved it again. My partner said the sky only shows certain photos, but at the time I thought the first save had failed.

I removed a photo from the sky to free space and assumed it would delete the copy from my phone too. It did not, and I had already deleted the original from my camera roll because I thought the app had it.

The save timed out. I tapped retry three times because nothing happened. Later I had three of the same note in the feed. I do not know which one my partner read or whether deleting two of them removes the photo.

I was joining Eli's space on the shared tablet when I realised I was signed in with my old account. I signed out and signed in as myself. For a moment the app still showed the space from the old account, and I panicked that I had joined as the wrong person.

After Chen left, I still had the invite button. I made a new code and sent it to my sister to see if it worked, because I wanted to start again with someone else. It kept saying the space already had its partner. Nothing in the app told me the code could never work.

My new phone lost the connection halfway through restoring from the phrase. I was afraid the phrase had been used up. I tried again and it worked, but the screen did not tell me whether the first attempt had left anything half-created.

I cannot find the paper with the phrase. My old phone is gone. I asked Mira whether she could approve my new phone from hers, and she said she did not know. I assumed support could get the photos back because we pay for the app.

I restored on a new phone and gave the old one to a family member. I assumed restoring meant the old phone was no longer trusted. I never opened the devices screen because I did not know there was one.

I bought Plus mainly for the storage. Quinn was still on the free plan in the app and asked whether she had to buy it too. I told her it was for both of us, but I was only guessing. The app did not show me what she would see.
I tapped the yearly plan, then cancelled at the store sheet because it was more than I expected. The app came back and for a second looked like it had Plus. I was not sure whether I had been charged.

We hit the storage limit while I was uploading a video. Grace tried to add one photo and got the same error. I deleted a memory but the counter did not move until I reopened the app. It felt like the limit belonged to me, not to us.

I opened Edit relationship and changed our anniversary date. The form let me fill everything in, then it just said it could not save and asked me to try again. I tried three times before Eli told me only the person who created the space can change it. The app never said that.

report.summary: OFFLINE FIXTURE ONLY. This file exists so the lab can be exercised without a MiroFish server, Zep Cloud, or an LLM key. It is not evidence that MiroFish produced these observations.
findings: Fictional users repeatedly conflate sharing an invitation with completed membership.
Fictional users do not reliably distinguish the Us sky from the dated memory archive.
Fictional users expect a cancelled purchase to leave entitlement unchanged and a partner purchase to apply to both members.
The fixture includes one cross-account hypothesis (a join finishing after an account switch) that the source analysis says is not guarded on the mutation path.
A fictional partner was offered an edit form that the server only allows the creator to use, and the UI reported a generic save failure.
